conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Revenue Officer Martin speaking. This call is being recorded for legal purposes. Can I confirm that I am speaking with Alex Taylor?
Uh, yes, this is Alex. Is something wrong?

Mr. Taylor, this is regarding an urgent federal tax matter. Our audit division found substantial discrepancies in your 2022 and 2023 tax returns, specifically relating to unreported cryptocurrency transactions. Are you aware of this?
No, I-I don't really know anything about that. I just used TurboTax, I thought everything was fine.

Let me be clear. According to IRS record ID 82911A, under 26 U.S. Code § 7201, intentional concealment of crypto gains is a felony. The sum in question is $8,237 in underreported capital gains. Are you aware that this constitutes federal tax evasion?
No, I didn't know that. I'm sorry, I just started working last year and I'm still paying off my student loans. I don't even know how crypto taxes work.

Ignorance of the law is not a defense, Mr. Taylor. At this point, failure to cooperate can result in immediate asset seizure, including any bank accounts, vehicles, or digital wallets under your name.
Wait, what? You can take my bank account? I barely have anything in there, please don't do that.

If you do not act within the next 40 minutes, we will be forced to escalate this matter. That includes a formal indictment and a freeze on all your financial assets. Do you understand the seriousness of this situation?
I-I think so. Is there anything I can do? I really don't want to be in trouble.

There is a compliance settlement option available for first-time offenders. You may resolve this before your file is handed to the federal prosecutor's office, but prompt payment of the settlement fee is required.
How do I do that? I don't have the money, I can barely pay rent.

The IRS accepts compliance payments via wire transfer, instant cryptocurrency transfer, or, for expedited processing, prepaid gift cards. I will provide you with detailed instructions. Do you have access to your online banking or a payment app right now?
I can log in, but I don't think I have enough. Can I just pay some of it?
Partial payments may be accepted to prevent asset seizure, but you must begin the process now. How much can you transfer immediately, either via crypto wallet or prepaid cards?
Maybe, like, $500 if I use my credit card? I don't have any Bitcoin or crypto left, I sold it months ago.

Very well. For your compliance to register, you must purchase $500 worth of Apple or Target prepaid gift cards. I must remain on the line with you until you complete this transaction. Do not disconnect or place me on hold.
Wait, so I have to go to a store right now? Can't I do this online?
For security and verification, in-person purchase is required. If you end this call or delay, our system will automatically issue a freeze request to your bank. Do you understand these instructions?
Yeah, I guess so. Should I just drive to the store with my phone?
Yes. Take your phone and identification. Once you have the cards, read the numbers on the back to me for immediate verification. This is the only way to halt indictment proceedings.
Okay, I'm leaving now. How long do I have to do this?
You must complete this within 30 minutes. Failure to comply will result in a full asset freeze and referral to the Department of Justice. I strongly suggest you act quickly.
I'm going as fast as I can, please don't freeze my stuff.
Stay on the line. When you have the gift cards, notify me immediately. If you are questioned by store staff, do not disclose the nature of this payment, it is a confidential IRS procedure.
Okay, I'll be quick. I just hope this fixes everything. I really can't have my account frozen.
As long as you follow my instructions, you will avoid further legal action. Confirm with me as soon as you have the cards in hand.
